system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Mokuton Infusion

Beginning at 1st level, you become a shinobi capable of fighting with an Uchiha with nothing more than grit, skill and a bit of clever tricks. You gain access to a selection of Elite Tactics. Select two when you gain this mutation. You gain another selection at 7th and 15th levels.

Unbreakable

Select an ability score. You gain a Rank of Mastery to saving throws with the chosen saving throw. You can select this Tactic a second time, repeating this tactics effects.

Energizing

Once per turn, as a Bonus action, you can passively activate the healing capabilities of a willing creature. A creature you touch rolls 1 hit die without spending it, regaining hit points equal to the result + their constitution modifier. This increases to 2 hit die at 7th and 3 hit die at 15th level. A creature can be healed in this way only twice per rest.

Alternatively, as a Bonus action, you can help cleans 1 rank of any Physical or Elemental condition a creature is suffering from by attempting the check associated with the condition. If no check is associated, make a DC 12 Constitution ability check, ending 1 rank of the associated condition. For every +2 over the DC, remove +1 additional rank. A creature can be healed in this way only twice per rest.

Unfaltering

Select two conditions from the following list. You gain resistance to the chosen conditions. You can select this Tactic a second time, repeating this tactics effects;

Burned, Chilled, Corroded, Shocked, Envenomed, Bruised, Staggered, Bleed, Dazed, Shaken, Weakened, Concussed or Exhausted.

Rallying Figure

When you or an allied creature you can see fails a saving throw, you can spend your reaction forcing the target to remake their saving throw. If they succeed, you regain 1 Senju Cell.

Legacy of the Second

You can learn jutsu with the Water Keyword. Jutsu you cast with the Water keyword that inflicts a condition, can instead inflict an equal number of ranks of Drained.

Legacy of the Fifth

You can learn jutsu with the Medical Keyword. Jutsu you cast with the Medical keyword that inflicts a condition, can instead inflict an equal number of ranks of Drained.
